A '''Human''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], along with a group of fellow hunters that included, among others, [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], attempted to steal the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen body of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] while in the [[Cadavine Sector Fleet Imperial Enclave]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].
